verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Phaser's editor (phaser.io/editor) provides visual scene/asset editing—drag-and-drop placement, animation tweaking, physics-body adjustment, filter effects—and an MCP agent that translates natural-language requests into code changes, but nothing describes a node-based or visual gameplay-logic scripting system that lets a technical artist build game logic without writing JavaScript/TypeScript code. Phaser remains fundamentally a code-first framework (phaser-gh-1, phaser-docs-4), so the 'no-code logic' capability is unevidenced.
